_about: v3 (25 Nov 2026): v2 plus the corrections accepted from the independent audit review (audit-review/) and the AURIX re-verified on the live pages (xcheck/aurix-reverify.json). Rule unchanged: page-read prices; a figure no page gives is labelled.

AURIX pair.note: Re-verified 25 Nov 2026: authorised list ceiling $31.56 at 1,000 (Infineon shop = Digi-Key, KXUMA2, one reel); China distributor own stock $14.82 at 100+ (LCSC) and ¥79.38 ex-VAT (szlcsc) — a market floor, not a traceable Tier-1 channel; Infineon: automotive annual pricing 'low single-digit price declines' (Q2 FY26). Range $15–21 for a 20,000-a-year buyer; point $17 = £13.40. Not a contract price — replace with Dana's.

U39, U40.note: Audit: Newark $3.99 / $3.90 / $3.82 at 1,000 / 2,500 / 5,000; Digi-Key $4.11898 at 2,500 (zero stock) — $3.90 ÷ 1.27 = £3.07. Our re-read could not confirm it (Newark 503). v2's £7.68 (LCSC own stock at 100+) was a small-quantity listing. Identity (TLF35584) assumed from the silkscreen, not read.

DC-DC group.note: LMR33630 analogue rejected: TI's page shows LMR33630-Q1 only as VQFN-HR 12-pin; the board shows a QFN-16. Priced at the tool's class point (DC-DC converter QFN, catalogue p10–p90 of 52 AEC-Q parts) until the part is read.

U35, U36.note: ISO7741 analogue rejected: TI's page shows ISO7741QDWRQ1 as wide SOIC-16; the board shows a TSSOP-20. Priced at the tool's class point (interface transceiver, catalogue p10–p90 of 55 AEC-Q parts) until the part is read.

linesChecked.J12 CUSTOMER: 776087-1 is a 23-way AMPSEAL (Master Electronics $5.72 at 1,000 = £4.50); our £5.52 is that part scaled × 1.4 for 34 ways — kept; the real 34-way part number is needed

burden.note: The tool's sourced EMS material burden at 10,000 boards (cost-plus EMS practice: 10 % at 1k, 7 % at 10k, 5 % at 100k+ boards); the audit's 5 % applies at 100k+, v2's 6 % was unsourced.

board.note: The tool's market basis (server/data/pcb-market-evidence.ts): Chaoying (超颖) 4–6-layer automotive ASP ¥995.31/m² (2024) × 1.145 (mid of the +12–17 % automotive PCB rise to Q1 2026) × the China table's 6-v-5-layer shape + ¥105/m² class-3 extras (PCBasic). v2 took the top of the rise band and no layer shape; the audit's £16 (range £12–22) was a judgement.

assembly.smtNote: JLCPCB Standard PCBA, more than 100,000 joints an order: $0.0012 per SMT joint (page updated 22 Oct 2026), paste and AOI inside
assembly.thtNote: JLCPCB manual / wave THT joint at its top tier $0.012 (Huaqiu ¥0.10)
assembly.xrayNote: JLCPCB X-ray $0.16 per component at 1,001–3,000 — the tier a 1,000-board lot (2,000 BGAs) reaches (audit P6; v2 took the annual tier $0.082)
listed: SMT assembly incl. paste and AOI (per joint)
assembly.markupNote: List prices are selling prices — they carry the seller's margin, so no SG&A or profit is added on them (audit P2 / P5; v2 added 10 % + 8 %). Operations priced from rate-book time × rate carry 10 % overhead; £0.14 a board set-up / handling allowance (the audit's).
assembly.unchanged: Conformal coating, press-fit, staking, masking, ICT, programming, functional / HV test and final inspection: no page-read volume price — rate-book time × rate, unverified
